coverage_regimes.name: decode_like
coverage_regimes.requirement: support batches containing query lengths from 1 to 16 against KV histories from the 4k-input/256-output lifecycle

coverage_regimes.name: prefill_like
coverage_regimes.requirement: support one or more query segments with hundreds of tokens through the 4k-input prefill scale

coverage_regimes.name: ragged_mixed
coverage_regimes.requirement: support a single batch mixing decode-like and prefill-like requests without assuming uniform lengths

coverage_regimes.name: cuda_graph_padding
coverage_regimes.requirement: support batches with inactive zero-length request slots and q.shape[0] larger than the active query prefix

distribution_profile.basis: metadata.shapes.frequency normalized within this operator and rounded to whole percentages with the largest-remainder method

kv_split_pattern_definitions.comparable_histories: at least two kv_lengths are positive and max(positive kv_lengths) / min(positive kv_lengths) < 2
kv_split_pattern_definitions.long_tail_histories: at least two kv_lengths are positive and max(positive kv_lengths) / min(positive kv_lengths) >= 4
kv_split_pattern_definitions.skewed_histories: at least two kv_lengths are positive and 2 <= max(positive kv_lengths) / min(positive kv_lengths) < 4

distribution_profile.optimization_priority: Use these aggregate shares to prioritize common fast paths; correctness is still required across the full shape_domain.

query_split_pattern_definitions.balanced_segments: at least two query_lengths are positive and max(query_lengths) / sum(query_lengths) < 0.55
query_split_pattern_definitions.dominant_plus_tail: at least two query_lengths are positive and 0.55 <= max(query_lengths) / sum(query_lengths) < 0.80
query_split_pattern_definitions.one_dominant_segment: at least two query_lengths are positive and max(query_lengths) / sum(query_lengths) >= 0.80

evaluation.performance_requirement: performance is measured across hidden cases after correctness passes

invariants: query_start_loc is the inclusive prefix sum of query_lengths, starts at 0, and ends at active_query_tokens, which may be less than q.shape[0] because q uses CUDA Graph slots
each query_lengths[i] is less than or equal to kv_lengths[i]
max_seqlen_q equals max(query_lengths) and max_seqlen_k equals max(kv_lengths)
q.shape is [cuda_graph_query_slots, 16, 256], active_query_tokens is at most cuda_graph_query_slots, and inactive output slots remain zero
block_table.shape is [batch_size, block_table_columns] and its valid prefix maps each request to compact non-overlapping cache pages
seqused_k contains kv_lengths as int32 values
zero query and KV lengths represent inactive padded request slots and are skipped by the reference
an individual request has at most 4578 logical context tokens including MTP lookahead; only packed query slots across concurrent requests may reach 8192
the candidate must derive dispatch decisions from runtime properties and must not depend on evaluator shape ids
objective: Implement one flash-attention candidate that is correct and fast for the public 4k-input/256-output workload domain; exact evaluator cases are hidden.

operator_contract.accumulation_target: float32 reference semantics within evaluator tolerance
operator_contract.attention: causal variable-length paged GQA with bottom-right causal alignment
operator_contract.scheduler_metadata: enabled for every shapes.json case; input.py may return None only when the vLLM helper is unavailable

block_table_columns.note: This is the fixed physical table capacity/stride in shapes.json, not a logical sequence-length limit.

workload_profile.note: The 4578-token maximum includes three MTP speculative tokens beyond the 4319+256 lifecycle; 8192 is a packed CUDA Graph slot total, not a per-request context.
